intro_pages: Welcome to BLTHLL. What you're looking at isn't your computer's terminal.
We here at Walnut Industries have taken control of your computer, and locked
your super sick games library behind a series of puzzles (I'm maniacally
laughing, I wish you could hear it).
In order to progress through this game, er, test... I mean test... you will
need to discover a decidedly finite quantity of secrets, possible only by
On this computer you'll find tools you might know well, or that you might
need some introduction to. You're not alone: 'help' lists what's at your
disposal, and 'man <command>' explains it. Puzzles can usually be solved
more than one way. Look around the filesystem. Read things you shouldn't.
If you'd rather play games, we give you one for each puzzle you solve.
Python is available too, though we've limited it so it isn't too powerful.
And our AI Division has provided some... assistants. Use at your own risk.
welcome: Type 'start' to play, 'help' for commands, or just look around.
